economy.assessment: The session completed in about 8.88 minutes, comfortably within the 15-minute budget, and finalized without retry. The metadata records 51 committed patch operations; the transcript contains 81 total tool calls including inspections, intermediate edits, and finalize. Operations were broadly proportionate to the unusually comprehensive request. There were no add-delete-rebuild cycles or repeated NO-OPs. Some sticky sizing and delivery-label placement required iterative correction, but these were progressive lint-driven refinements rather than destructive thrash.
